note: Boot sets hw-test.yml runs, by SHA-256. The runner host supplies the files under $DATAX_LAB_ARTIFACTS/<place>-<image>/ and scripts/hw/tron-run.sh refuses any file whose hash differs. Changing an image means a new entry here (and new evidence).
